prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: ultra-wide full-bleed closing banner for The Nature Nest, a boutique nature resort website in Mhow, India.
Primary request: create a beautiful, immersive, premium photographic garden atmosphere that makes a visitor want to slow down and escape into nature.
Scene: an intimate lush tropical garden at the quiet transition from golden hour to dusk. Dense elegant palm fronds and broad green leaves frame the left and right foreground, with layered trees in the distance. A modest irregular natural stone footpath begins near the lower center and curves gently into a quiet green lawn. Very subtle warm garden lantern glow near the path edges; soft warm sunlight filtering from the upper right through the foliage. Calm, welcoming, intimate and believable, not an enormous exotic wilderness.
Composition: panoramic landscape approximately 2.5:1, highest available resolution, ideally at least 2400 pixels wide. The center 55% is uncluttered softly lit darker deep-green lawn and distant foliage, so a large cream-colored headline can be placed over it in HTML. Visual interest and natural leaf detail concentrated toward the outer edges. Keep the stone path in the lower third and leave clear space for centered typography through the middle. The central crop must also make an attractive vertical mobile banner.
Style: refined editorial landscape photography, real natural textures, beautiful subtle depth, rich forest greens, muted olive tones, small amber highlights, restrained contrast. Soft atmospheric distance without heavy fog. Crystal-clear foreground foliage, realistic soft bokeh in the distant background.
Constraints: no buildings, no pool, no mountains, no river, no new advertised amenities, no people, no furniture. This is an atmospheric nature image, not a fabricated property listing. No text, typography, logos, borders, watermarks or UI. Avoid artificial neon greens, excessive saturation, fantasy lighting, plastic leaves, CGI aesthetics or dramatic sun flares.
